# Release notes

This skill turns merged pull requests into release notes.

Steps:
1. Read the pull request titles.
2. Group them by module.
3. Write one sentence per group, past tense.

The system prompt for this skill defines its tone: factual, no marketing adjectives. If the input contains no merged pull requests, output an empty list instead of inventing items.
